text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after the Japanese Derby, Tokai Teio begins training hard for the Kikuka Sho. It's said only the strongest Umamusume can win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she pushes herself too hard and hurts her legs. She's told she may not even be able to enter the Kikuka Sho in her state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nonetheless, she stubbornly insists on continuing to train, declaring she'll enter the race no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her so fired up, I look into various types of treatment for her, and eventually she gets back to running form.
